# Latent Variable Modelling {.course-title .unnumbered}

::: {.lead}

[under construction] A four-part lecture series on latent variable models — from the conceptual
foundations through exploratory and confirmatory factor analysis to full
structural equation models. Every model is worked twice: once in **R** and once
in **Mplus**, with replicable code and annotated output.
